title: Nile cruise price calculator
standfirst: See how one cruise price builds up, step by step, from a starting price. It explains prices rather than quoting them. For a price for your dates, check rates on each cruise. This tool is part of our guide to [[up]].

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Each row is one step from the starting price, and the total is their sum. More choices will be added once operators approve euro prices for them.

sections.heading: Where the figures come from
paragraphs: The figures are per person, in euros, and already include our margin: a guide, not a quote. All prices we publish and quote already include our margin. Crew gratuities, flights and transfers are never included.

faqs.a: No. It shows how prices are built. For your dates, check rates on each cruise, and we’ll send your offer by email.

seoDescription: See how the boat, the sightseeing, the cabin and the season build up the price of a Nile cruise, per person in euros.
